title: Replication Package and Empirical Dataset: Five Viral Myths of AI Code Review Fatigue—Tested Against 130,000+ Production Pull Requests
description:
Open-science replication package and empirical dataset accompanying the practitioner study Five Viral Myths of AI Code Review Fatigue—Tested Against 130,000+ Production Pull Requests.

Empirical Scope (Zero Synthetic Data): 99,454 longitudinal CodeRabbit OSS pull requests (457 tenure repos; 87,899 fixed-cohort PRs across 362 repos active ≥61 days), 33,596 autonomous coding-agent PRs and 6,618 human baseline PRs across 2,807 active repositories (≥100 stars), 6,004 formal human reviews across 2,491 distinct reviewers (purified 38-bot catalog), 553 TypeSafe Jev decision-model PRs (N=312 hydrated), 150 human-audited CodeReviewBench prose-bot critiques, and 10,410 merged pull requests attributed to post-merge bugfix commits and reverts across 300 bare-git SZZ clones.

Contents: 36 SHA-256 verified JSON, Markdown, and CSV audit artifacts (including the 10,410-PR SZZ traceability ledger), standalone DuckDB/SciPy analysis pipeline scripts, zero-API dataset fetcher, and a one-command 81-check verification harness (python3 replication/run_replication.py) verified in both offline and full raw-recomputation modes.
